create.name: Ryan Powell
create.bio:
Ryan Powell teaches Daoist qigong and tai chi in Portland, Oregon. He began studying with Qigong Master Zhongxian Wu in 2002, has made trips to China to practise at the sources of that tradition, and is authorised by Master Wu to pass on the Hidden Immortal Lineage. Alongside qigong his training over more than twenty-five years takes in internal martial arts and the I Ching, and he teaches movement forms from the Emei Zhengong line together with the rarely seen Zhaobao He style of taijiquan.

His group classes in Portland are open to beginners and follow a steady pattern: each session opens with a loose shaking practice, moves through a set form and ends sitting quietly to gather the energy that has been raised. He also gives one-to-one lessons in person or over Zoom. Ryan is a working musician too, playing Celtic guitar, harp and whistle, and he blends the two strands in Xu, a podcast of short musical meditations on the Daoist idea of emptiness. His style is patient and unhurried, and he encourages students to let the forms settle in over time until the practice feels like their own.

courses.description: One-to-one lessons with Ryan, in Portland or over Zoom, shaped around what the student wants to learn from his qigong and tai chi forms. Get in touch with him to arrange times and fees.

free_resources.title: Xu, the Podcast about Emptiness
free_resources.description: Ryan's free podcast of short musical meditations, with harp and whistle woven around simple reflections on the Daoist theme of emptiness. Episodes play on Apple Podcasts, Spotify and Buzzsprout.

flags: Thin listing: no current group class is posted (the summer 2026 Monday/Wednesday series ended 26 Aug and the events page shows nothing upcoming), so the page rests on private lessons, the podcast and four older YouTube videos.
The Xu podcast's latest episode is from August 2024; it is still online but may be dormant.
Email domain (qigongwithryan.com) differs from his site's domain; it is the address printed on his contact page.
Location: his site and Insight Timer say Portland, OR; a MapQuest listing places him in Lake Oswego, a Portland suburb.
His YouTube channel is named 'Ryan Powell Music' and is mostly Celtic music; only the four teaching videos are listed. A second channel (@ryanpowell2714) holds the rain qigong video.
The past summer class blurb described the joint qigong form as healing the body; it is general, not condition-named, and the class is left out anyway as dated.
left_out: Opening the Spiritual Fortress Joint Qigong series (3 Jun to 26 Aug 2026, already finished).

Celtic band The Host of the Air (music, not teaching).
